name: amira-mcp-server
description: Read-only access to the Africa Multiple Cluster research data (AMIRA collection on Omeka S).
long_description:
Search and explore the research data of the Africa Multiple Cluster of Excellence, as published on the cluster's public Omeka S site (https://data.africamultiple.uni-bayreuth.de): research projects across four partner universities (Bayreuth, Lagos, Joseph Ki-Zerbo, Bahia) plus external collections such as the International Library of African Music, organised into thematic research sections, with ~4,000 digitised research items, people, institutions, groups, an academic bibliography, podcast episodes, and the cluster's YouTube videos with searchable transcripts.

No API key, database, or VPN is required. A complete data snapshot is bundled in the extension, so the server works fully offline. When enabled (default), it also refreshes itself from the site's public API.

Every record carries an `amira_url` — its public page on the Omeka S site — so results can be cited as links back to the source.

tools.name: get_collection_overview
tools.description: Counts and breakdowns across the whole collection + snapshot freshness. Start here.

tools.name: search_research_items
tools.description: Search ~4,000 research items by keyword, subject, location, contributor, project, section, university, resource type, format/genre, language, and year.

tools.name: get_research_item
tools.description: Full metadata for one research item by dre_id: dates, contributors with roles, places with hierarchy, sponsors, formats, related items.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search the cluster's research projects by keyword, university, section, PI, member, or funding institution.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full detail for one project, with item breakdown and top subjects.

tools.name: list_research_sections
tools.description: The cluster's thematic sections with funding phases, PIs and counts.

tools.name: get_research_section
tools.description: Full detail for one research section, including its projects.

tools.name: search_persons
tools.description: Search the people authority list by name (either order) or affiliation.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Profile aggregating a person's projects led/joined, items contributed, and publications.

tools.name: list_institutions
tools.description: List institutions with project counts and coordinates.

tools.name: get_institution
tools.description: One institution's or group's projects, affiliated people, and contributed items.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List research groups.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: Subject headings (tags merged in) ranked by item frequency, each with its authority page.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Places (country/region/city via the place hierarchy) ranked by item count, with coordinates.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Facet values: formats/genres, languages, resource types.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search the cluster bibliography by keyword, author, type, or year.

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Full metadata and BibTeX for one publication.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Cross-entity discovery: pivot from a subject/place/person/project to co-occurring entities.

tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description: Search cluster podcast episodes by keyword, series, person, or year.

tools.name: get_podcast
tools.description: Full detail for one podcast episode (incl. transcript when available).

tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Search the cluster's YouTube videos — including full-text search over transcripts.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Full detail for one video, including its transcript.

live_refresh.title: Refresh data from the live site
live_refresh.description: When on, the server checks the public Omeka S API for newer data at startup and updates its local cache. Turn off to run fully offline using only the bundled snapshot.

cache_dir.title: Refreshed-data cache directory
cache_dir.description: Where to store data refreshed from the site. Leave default to use your home directory (~/.amira-mcp/cache).

site_base.title: Site base URL (advanced)
site_base.description: Override the Omeka S site base URL used for citations and refresh. Defaults to https://data.africamultiple.uni-bayreuth.de.
